what: Each model slimmed to 50 / 25 / 12 / 6 % of its triangles and to the fixed budgets 20,000 / 10,000 / 5,000 / 2,500 below its full count, and each level measured against the full model (slim_levels.mjs).

method.frame: each model turned back by its real turn in the 3D team's scene (front = three.js +z = Max -Y), footprint centred, base at y = 0, metres; the parts merged into one geometry
method.slimming: SimplifyModifier (three 0.186.1; meshoptimizer's simplify, target error 1, no locked borders) on the merged model welded by position at 0.1 mm with its normals dropped; each level made from the full model; the count passed is the vertices to remove that gives the target share of the triangles
method.outline: filled silhouettes on a 2 mm grid seen from the front (along z), the side (along x) and the top (along y); a cell counts when its centre is inside a triangle; IoU = cells in both / cells in either; lost / added = cells only in the full / only in the slimmed model
method.area: surface area of the slimmed model / of the full model (all triangles, hidden ones too)
method.gap: points on each surface (its welded vertices, at most 100,000, plus 100,000 spread by area, fixed seed) to the nearest point of the other surface (three-mesh-bvh 0.9.16 closestPointToPoint): fullToSlim = what the slimmed model misses, slimToFull = where it stands away from the full one; 'visible' = the points from which a ray in one of 26 directions (the cube's faces, edges and corners) gets away without hitting the surface they lie on; largestGapSeen_mm = the larger of the two visible maxima
